title: Hoboken Terminal

terrainReference.basis: Dry Warrington Plaza pavement outside the north vestibule street wall and projecting entrance canopy; not inner hall roof, water or gangway.

note: Joined ferry/rail terminal with six true open slips, five plaza gables, own vestibule/waiting-room/south rooms and reconstructed brown clock tower. Western platform sheds/baggage/Pullman buildings excluded. Independent USGS1m land/water terrain retained unchanged; marine supports and fixed gangway pose are bounded visual approximations without tide/seabed survey. Footprint replacement disabled.
